author: Pelpelajax
body:
Hey guys! I thought I would make this nice an easy. So how do you get a void world without having to download a void map? 

So what you do is...

1) Select a Superflat world
 
2) Click on customize
3) Click on presets 

4) In the bar above, write; 2;0;1
5) Once you have done this, click use preset. You are now ready to create your world.

NOTE: If you you want to place a block you have to use this command; /setblock [Coordinates] [Block ID]

replies.author: Shoto_
replies.body:
I personally go to Superflat, then for a preset I type  [1;12;1] (sand) and make sure that pre built things are off. Then I place a block then the sand falls, leaving void. You won't have to type anything except the preset number, so use that if you're lazy :D
It just gets laggy when it ripples, so I turn default on and set my render distance to 2 and then save and exit after sand has fallen then join again so I don't get lag.

TL;DR:  [1;12;1] for a superflat preset with built things off.
